services.name: Tandem
services.desc: To make a tandem skydive is to feel truly free! When you fly to 10,000 feet and leap into the big blue sky, you have no choice but to be fully present in the moment - and it feels so, so good! Can you picture it? Freefalling at an adrenaline-soaked 120 mph and then sailing peacefully under parachute - high above life’s everyday challenges, basking in the realization of how good it is to be alive. Ahhhh … By the time you touch down, you’ve gained a whole new perspective. You feel empowered, enriched, and inspired - it’s the ultimate attitude adjustment!! blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving with options for video/photo packages and a no-wait 'Red Carpet' option. They also offer an Accelerated Freefall (AFF) student program to learn to skydive solo and earn a license. The center provides parachute rigging, inspection, repacking, and repair services by an FAA Master Parachute Rigger.
